raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On the baseline, ERNIE-Image passes a 4D spatial latent into generic sequence sharding, so a native Ulysses2 request fails before model execution. Its DiT also keeps the joint image/text stream replicated and disables sequence-parallel attention. This enables image-prefix sharding inside the DiT and makes the existing two-GPU path useful for high-resolution requests.

## Modifications

- Keep spatial latents intact at the pipeline boundary; shard image tokens after embedding and retain the replicated text suffix.
- Reuse `build_shard_plan`, `shard_seq_prefix`, and existing USP suffix attention. Preserve global RoPE positions and gather only the narrow final image patches.
- Retain dense execution for masked text, uneven image-token counts, and Ring; add focused two-rank model/pipeline tests and update the ERNIE cookbook.

## Accuracy Tests

Baseline: `af21e2b989e482cfdce39689126562f2209d53ac`  
Final head: `4c358e57a4d62786f6c2ee6995a4c0a542822835`  
Pre-cleanup: `f9ff536a3cb6e612cb4494e366a307b0f7d037e0`  
Turbo checkpoint: `baidu/ERNIE-Image-Turbo@bc68c81e2a1730a394d5fc9fae70713dee940140`  
Standard checkpoint: `baidu/ERNIE-Image@5346b31d68c9c23758ba56ef8be5e9dc174c7f99`.

The CPU suite passes 31 tests with three CUDA-only skips. Two-rank tests use the actual small DiT with batch two, short/long/revisited text, uneven image tokens, masked text, and dense Ring fallback. Native full-model Turbo2048 and standard1024 checks produce eight main-identical PNGs per tested candidate revision. Final exact/high/lossless checks match within each tier, and four Ring fallback images match main. High here is not FP8/NVFP4 validation.

The final PNG0 sequences verify 338 outputs without the Omni prompt cache and 139 with it, including warmups and state checks. Every output matches its own prior RGB reference. All same-request SGLang main/pre-cleanup/final PNG0 files are byte-identical. Pre-commit and cookbook validation pass. Final runtime/test ASTs match the tested and profiled revisions; formal GPU engines execute the final commit itself.

Actual short and long prompt outputs from main and the final commit follow. Original PNGs, full requests, hashes, and preview provenance are archived.

![ERNIE-Image-Turbo actual main and final outputs](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/releases/download/b300-ernie-sp-evidence-20261104/main-vs-final.jpg)

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Fixed physical B300 GPU0/1 pool, 275040 MiB per GPU, NV18, driver 590.48.01. Main uses GPU0; pre-cleanup/final use Ulysses2 on GPU0/1. This restores scaling within the same two-GPU ceiling; GPU counts differ. Native Turbo2048², BF16 DiT/text/VAE, eight steps, CFG1, CPU seed42, PE off, resident components, lossless quality, and explicit PNG0. SGLang runs eager with BCG and torch.compile disabled.

The short prompt is “A red ceramic teapot on a wooden table beside a window, morning sunlight, photographic detail.” Requests are sequential at concurrency one and repeat the prompt after warmup. The timer covers native SDK generation through completed PNG saving; hashing and quality checks are outside it. No profiler or synchronized-stage hooks run during formal timing.

After two A/A engines per arm, `[main, pre-cleanup, final, final, pre-cleanup, main]` runs twice. Every engine has three warmups, six timed requests, then long/short-revisit state checks. Each paired arm has 24 formal requests from four fresh engines.

| Arm | GPUs | Saved E2E p50 / p95 (s) | Separate denoise diagnostics (s) | Sequential images/s | Output-rank peak reserved MiB |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Main | 1 | 2.6155 / 2.6318 | 2.4345 / 2.4382 | 0.3825 | 39852 |
| Before cleanup | 2 | 1.4818 / 1.4942 | — | 0.6726 | 40404 |
| Final | 2 | 1.4781 / 1.4866 | 1.2970 / 1.2985 | 0.6760 | 40272 |

Empirical p95 is over 24 paired requests, and images/s is reciprocal mean latency at concurrency one, not saturated HTTP throughput. Memory is the returned allocator high-water mark on the output rank, not the sum across GPUs.

| Round | Main / final mean engine median (s) | E2E reduction | Cleanup latency change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 2.603648 / 1.473747 | 43.397% | -0.250% |
| 2 | 2.624297 / 1.480429 | 43.588% | -0.335% |

A/A absolute engine-median changes: main 0.6015%, pre 0.3402%, final 0.1099%. Cleanup removes a local RoPE wrapper and duplicate slicing by reusing the existing prefix utility. It shows no measured regression in either symmetric round.

| Arm | Engine initialization range (s) | Initialization + three warmups (s) |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Main | 34.03–38.34 | 44.25–49.89 |
| Final Ulysses2 | 41.25–43.84 | 50.70–53.35 |

Separate synchronized denoise diagnostics are main 2.4345/2.4382s and candidate 1.2970/1.2985s; VAE is about 0.113–0.116s. The candidate profile is from `9ceed905`, whose Python AST matches the final head. Both candidate ranks were exported. Main GEMM kernel sum is 1316.230ms, versus 565.117/568.458ms per candidate rank. Peer head-copy kernels add 11.145/10.893ms; named NCCL kernels exclude these custom communication kernels. Trace sums, active unions, and spans are distinct quantities. NCU counters were unavailable; no occupancy or hardware-stall claim is made.

**Native vLLM-Omni comparator.** Frozen `817d4c17feb702289a2d2b2cbacfd594c262b7a7`, same checkpoint and request contract, native Ulysses2, with default regional compilation enabled. Eager2 and compiled1 were also screened and retained. The existing prompt-embedding cache is additionally tested with `enable_prompt_embed_cache=True, prompt_embed_cache_size=32`; both ranks record real cache hits and all seven diagnostic outputs remain exact to their own references. Formal workers contain neither stage nor cache observers.

Each compiled2 sequence has two A/A engines per arm followed by `[Omni, final, final, Omni]` twice, using three warmups and six timed requests per engine. Cached and uncached sequences remain separate.

| Omni configuration | Round 1 Omni / final (s), speedup | Round 2 Omni / final (s), speedup | A/A Omni / final |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Compiled2 | 2.8715 / 1.4791, 1.9414× | 2.9459 / 1.4835, 1.9857× | 2.869% / 0.156% |
| Compiled2 + native prompt cache | 2.9268 / 1.4831, 1.9735× | 2.9227 / 1.4839, 1.9696× | 1.040% / 0.227% |

Both complete sequences are disclosed; small cached/uncached differences within process noise do not prove a cache speedup. The fastest observed native compiled choice is `uncached2`. These are repeated-prompt results, not cold-prompt latency.

| Omni configuration | Paired E2E p50 / p95 (s) | Images/s | Reported peak MiB | Init + three warmups range (s) | Diagnostic denoise rank0 / rank1 (s) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Compiled2 | 2.8951 / 3.0998 | 0.3417 | 46882 | 54.32–59.44 | 2.1040 / 2.1178 |
| Compiled2 + cache | 2.9268 / 3.0402 | 0.3422 | 46882 | 52.23–58.97 | 2.1176 / 2.1251 |

Omni denoise is measured around the actual eight-step transformer/scheduler loop with synchronization. Its native startup dummy is excluded. These separate diagnostics are not formal E2E samples; the full stage report includes VAE/text timings. The main/candidate environment uses Torch2.14.1+cu130, Triton3.8.0, Diffusers0.37.0, FA4 4.0.0b36; Omni uses Torch2.13.0+cu130, vLLM0.32.0, Triton3.7.1, Diffusers0.40.0, FA4 4.0.0b18. Full effective dependencies and import provenance are in the package.

**Quality limits.** At the predeclared PSNR28dB/SSIM0.95 gate, compiled Omni short2048 passes at 30.9409dB/0.968375, but long2048 fails at 25.5581dB/0.927449. Only the short cell supports the cross-framework speed claim. Long remains a failed cell and state check, shown below. SGLang native TP2 also fails the short gate (27.1347dB/0.949024), so it is not a quality-equivalent baseline.

![Actual cross-framework outputs including the failed long prompt](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/releases/download/b300-ernie-sp-evidence-20261104/omni-quality.jpg)

**Other limits and retained attempts.** Turbo1024 and standard1024 can be slower with Ulysses2. Native BCG replays with matching warmup shape but differs from eager; SP2 default-PE warmup also reproduced an IPC hang. The PE-off control replays 32 serving calls per rank without new capture and matches BCG main, still differing from eager. These are compatibility findings, not new BCG coverage. Masked/uneven/Ring execution uses dense fallback; no Ring acceleration, general TP combination, or quantized-model benefit is claimed.

Earlier SGLang tests inherited PNG level4 while Omni used PNG0. Those measurements and the roughly0.52s output-saving variability are retained and marked as historical; their mixed-encoding ratios do not qualify this comparison. The tables above use new explicit PNG0 runs and are not pooled with them.

**Reproduction:** [complete evidence and commands](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/releases/tag/b300-ernie-sp-evidence-20261104). The review package includes source bundles, final/cleanup patches, environment inventories, request fixtures, every measured sample, failures, stage/profile summaries and original scripts. Three SHA256-verified raw archives retain original media, logs and traces; restore them in the documented order. The code diff contains no benchmark media, traces or weights.

```bash
# After restoring the evidence and recorded environments:
cd /personal/diffusion-b300-20261103
# Copy a recorded config to a fresh job name as shown in README.md.
envs/sglang/bin/python -u scripts/ernie_sp_run_png0_v2.py inputs/NEW_FINAL_CONFIG.json
envs/vllm-omni/bin/python -u scripts/ernie_omni_run_v2.py inputs/NEW_OMNI_CONFIG.json
```

## Checklist

- [x] Scoped source review and pinned pre-commit checks.
- [x] CPU model tests, native GPU quality, profile and final-head paired timings.
- [x] Cleanup retest, same-tier and fallback checks, actual main/final media.
- [x] Cookbook update; no new flags or dependencies.
- [ ] Upstream GPU CI/reviewer approval (Draft).

 - `--performance-mode auto` keeps conservative defaults while preserving explicit user flags.
 - If the checkpoint includes a PE component, SGLang loads it automatically with the native Ministral3 runtime. Use `--layerwise-offload-components pe` when the local PE decoder needs to trade latency for lower GPU memory usage.
-- Treat FSDP, SP/Ulysses/Ring, and TP as explicit benchmark knobs. Measure the target resolution, step count, and GPU type before making them production defaults.
+- On NVIDIA CUDA, use `--num-gpus 2 --tp-size 1 --ulysses-degree 2 --encoder-parallel replicate` to shard the DiT image tokens across two GPUs while retaining the full text on each rank. Both checkpoints use this path. Measure your target resolution: communication can make smaller images slower.

+- FSDP, TP, caching, and breakable CUDA graphs need separate validation; the Ulysses path does not establish compatibility with these features.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.dits.ernie_image import (
+    ErnieImageArchConfig,
+    ErnieImageDitConfig,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed.parallel_state import (
+    maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.managers.forward_context import set_forward_context
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits import ernie_image
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.server_args import set_global_server_args
+
+
+def _worker(mode):
+    set_global_server_args(
+        SimpleNamespace(
+            attention_backend="torch_sdpa",
+            attention_backend_config={},
+            kv_gather_degree=1,
+            sp_split_auto=False,
+        )
+    )
+    maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel(
+        tp_size=1,
+        sp_size=2,
+        ulysses_degree=2 if mode == "ulysses" else 1,
+        ring_degree=1 if mode == "ulysses" else 2,
+    )
+    config = ErnieImageDitConfig(
+        arch_config=ErnieImageArchConfig(
+            in_channels=4,
+            out_channels=4,
+            num_layers=2,
+            num_attention_heads=4,
+            attention_head_dim=16,
+            ffn_hidden_size=128,
+            text_in_dim=32,
+            rope_axes_dim=(4, 6, 6),
+        )
+    )
+    torch.manual_seed(42)
+    model = ernie_image.ErnieImageTransformer2DModel(config, {}).eval()
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for parameter in model.parameters():
+            parameter.normal_(std=0.1)
+    with torch.inference_mode(), set_forward_context(0, None):
+        for height, width, length, masked in [
+            (3, 4, 3, False),
+            (3, 4, 5, False),
+            (3, 3, 3, False),
+            (3, 4, 5, True),
+            (3, 4, 3, False),
+        ]:
+            torch.manual_seed(length)
+            latents = torch.randn(2, 4, height, width)
+            text = torch.randn(2, length, 32)
+            mask = None
+            if masked:
+                mask = torch.ones(2, length, dtype=torch.bool)
+                mask[0, -2:] = False
+            args = (latents, text, torch.tensor([630.0, 500.0]))
+            kwargs = {"encoder_hidden_states_mask": mask}
+            with patch.object(ernie_image, "get_sp_world_size", return_value=1):
+                expected = model(*args, **kwargs)
+            with patch.object(
+                ernie_image, "gather_seq", wraps=ernie_image.gather_seq
+            ) as gather:
+                actual = model(*args, **kwargs)
+            sharded = mode == "ulysses" and height * width % 2 == 0 and not masked
+            assert gather.call_count == int(sharded)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5)
+    dist.barrier()
+    dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(torch.version.hip is not None, reason="CPU workers hide GPUs")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["ulysses", "ring"])
+def test_two_rank_ernie_image_matches_dense(mode):
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [
+            sys.executable,
+            "-m",
+            "torch.distributed.run",
+            "--standalone",
+            "--nproc-per-node=2",
+            __file__,
+        ],
+        env={
+            **os.environ,
+            "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "",
+            "SGLANG_DIFFUSION_PLATFORM_OVERRIDE": "cpu",
+            "ERNIE_IMAGE_PARALLEL_WORKER": mode,
+        },
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        timeout=180,
+    )
+    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if mode := os.environ.get("ERNIE_IMAGE_PARALLEL_WORKER"):
+        _worker(mode)
+    else:
+        sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
